legend: Jon fought bravely to rescue the wildlings who were attacked by the white-walkers at Hardhome. On his arrival, Sam tells him that he wants to go to Oldtown to train at the Citadel to become a maester, so he can return and take the deceased Aemon's place as maester of Castle Black. Jon agrees to Sam's proposal and Sam sets off his journey to the Citadel. However becoming a trainee at the Citadel is not a cakewalk and hence the maesters at the Citadel gave Sam a problem to test his eligibility.

Initially Sam has a list with a single element n. Then he has to perform certain operations on this list. In each operation Sam must remove any element x, such that x > 1, from the list and insert at the same position ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png), ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e4b81f4486fb40815e4604649896be611e6c3c0.png), ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png) sequentially. He must continue with these operations until all the elements in the list are either 0 or 1.

Now the masters want the total number of 1s in the range l to r (1-indexed). Sam wants to become a maester but unfortunately he cannot solve this problem. Can you help Sam to pass the eligibility test?
input: The first line contains three integers n, l, r (0 ≤ n < 250, 0 ≤ r - l ≤ 105, r ≥ 1, l ≥ 1) – initial element and the range l to r.
It is guaranteed that r is not greater than the length of the final list.
output: Output the total number of 1s in the range l to r in the final sequence.
note: Elements on positions from 2-nd to 5-th in list is [1, 1, 1, 1]. The number of ones is 4.
Elements on positions from 3-rd to 10-th in list is [1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0]. The number of ones is 5.

output.ai: 输出最终序列中区间 l 到 r 内 1 的总数。

note.ai: 列表中第 2 个到第 5 个位置上的元素为 [1, 1, 1, 1]。1 的个数为 4。
列表中第 3 个到第 10 个位置上的元素为 [1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0]。其中 1 的数量为 5。

legend.ai: Jon 勇敢地奋战，营救了在 Hardhome 遭到异鬼袭击的野人。抵达后，Sam 告诉他，自己想前往 Oldtown，在学城学习，成为一名学士，这样他就能学成归来，接替已故的 Aemon，担任黑城堡的学士。Jon 同意了 Sam 的提议，于是 Sam 踏上了前往学城的旅程。然而，成为学城的学徒并非易事，因此学城的学士们给 Sam 出了一道题，以检验他是否具备资格。

最初，Sam 有一个仅包含单个元素 n 的列表。随后，他需要对这个列表执行一些操作。在每次操作中，Sam 必须从列表中移除任意一个满足 x > 1 的元素 x，并在同一位置依次插入 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png)、![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e4b81f4486fb40815e4604649896be611e6c3c0.png)、![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19f3313a25e01487b76a1f349881f013a6d5bc47.png)。他必须持续进行这些操作，直到列表中的所有元素都为 0 或 1。
现在，学士们想知道区间 l 到 r（从 1 开始编号）中 1 的总数。Sam 想成为一名学士，但遗憾的是他无法解决这道题。你能帮助 Sam 通过资格测试吗？

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n、l、r（0 ≤ n < 250，0 ≤ r - l ≤ 105，r ≥ 1，l ≥ 1），分别表示初始元素以及区间 l 到 r。
保证 r 不超过最终列表的长度。
